title: Weekly unbranded press-wire releases earned 108 AI answer citations
summary: Corey Haines describes a weekly newswire press-release program written around unbranded buyer questions for AI citation; in weeks it earned 108 repeating citations and lifted category prompt scores 21%.
question_it_answers: How fast can structured press-wire releases move AI-answer citation scores?

claims.text: Weekly neutral press releases around unbranded buyer questions earned 108 repeating AI citations in a few weeks.
